description: This file implements a DatabaseService class for interacting with a Supabase backend, providing user authentication, user profile management, and task management functionalities including creation, fetching, updating, deleting, and marking tasks as completed.

classes.name: DatabaseService
classes.description: A class encapsulating database operations for users and tasks with Supabase

methods.name: Dict[str,Any] create_user(self, user_data: UserCreate)
methods.description: Creates a new user account in Supabase Auth and inserts user profile data into the 'users' table

methods.name: Dict[str,Any] authenticate_user(self, email: str, password: str)
methods.description: Authenticates a user with email and password, retrieves user profile

methods.name: Optional[Dict[str,Any]] get_user_by_id(self, user_id: str)
methods.description: Fetches user profile by user ID

methods.name: Dict[str,Any] create_task(self, user_id: str, task_data: TaskCreate)
methods.description: Creates a new task linked to a user

methods.name: Dict[str,Any] get_tasks(self, user_id: str, task_filter: TaskFilter)
methods.description: Retrieves tasks for a user with filtering and pagination

methods.name: Optional[Dict[str,Any]] get_task_by_id(self, user_id: str, task_id: str)
methods.description: Fetches a specific task by its ID for a user

methods.name: Optional[Dict[str,Any]] update_task(self, user_id: str, task_id: str, task_data: TaskUpdate)
methods.description: Updates task data based on provided fields

methods.name: bool delete_task(self, user_id: str, task_id: str)
methods.description: Deletes a task by ID for a user

methods.name: Optional[Dict[str,Any]] mark_task_complete(self, user_id: str, task_id: str)
methods.description: Marks a task as completed and sets completion timestamp
